LanguageData.HE_Start_Yamato.label: Heirs of Yamato
LanguageData.HE_Start_Yamato.description: Five settlers of a Yamato clan clear new land in the shogun's name. They start with the Yamato heritage, a yari, a yumi, rice and a case of clan scrolls.
